body:
PR #10 (`STORY-80` / `ADR-82`) round-1 rework is pushed at `2d8d4bc` (https://github.com/joemooney/aida-host/pull/10), and PR #11 (`BUG-83` / `ADR-85`) is rebased on top of it (https://github.com/joemooney/aida-host/pull/11). Full test suite (`tests/test_cargo_wrapper.sh`) passes 100% (`ALL PASS`), and `STORY-80` / `ADR-82` remain `in-progress` until merge.

All 4 round-1 findings + threshold ruling and non-blocking items on PR #10 (`STORY-80`) are resolved:
1. **`AIDA_CARGO_SLOTS_MAX` validation (`bin/cargo`, `bin/cargo-log`):**
   - Validated against `^[0-9]+$`; non-numeric values (`abc`, `4x`, `3.5`) emit a warning on stderr and fall back to the default (`4` when `slots >= 2`, else `slots + 1`), and values `< slots` clamp to `slots`. Pinned by a test in Section 25.
2. **Cooldown applied whenever `burst.last` exists and any burst slot is held (`bin/cargo`):**
   - Added `slot_is_held()` so already-held burst slots are skipped before evaluating `burst_ok`, and `burst_ok` counts `burst_held` across all other burst slots (`slots .. slots_max - 1`).
   - Whenever `$dir/burst.last` exists and `burst_held > 0`, the `${AIDA_CARGO_BURST_COOLDOWN_S:-30}` s cooldown is enforced regardless of which burst slot index (`2` or `3`) is free.
3. **Tests & hermetic `AIDA_CARGO_MEMINFO` + threshold ruling (`40` for 1st burst slot, `30` for 2nd+):**
   - Exported `AIDA_CARGO_MEMINFO="$T/mem-default"` near line 43 of `tests/test_cargo_wrapper.sh` and made `burst_ok` fail closed when `meminfo` is unreadable or lacks `MemAvailable:`.
   - Pinned the default `30s` cooldown (`env -u AIDA_CARGO_BURST_COOLDOWN_S`) on both `{0,1,2} -> 3` (`cand > slots`) and `{0,1,3} -> 2` (`cand == slots` while slot 3 is held): `burst.last = now - 20` is denied (`rc = 124`, `burst_denied = "cooldown"`) and `burst.last = now - 31` is granted (`slot = 3` and `slot = 2`).
   - Implemented the threshold ruling: `cpu some avg10 < 40` (`AIDA_CARGO_BURST_CPU_MAX`) for the 1st burst slot (`slot 2`) and `< 30` (`AIDA_CARGO_BURST_CPU_MAX_2`) for the 2nd+ burst slot (`slot 3` or whenever another burst slot is held). Verified in the wrapper (`cpu=35%` grants slot 2 and denies slot 3; `cpu=50%` denies slot 3) and in `cargo ps --capacity` (`slots_max = 4` at `cpu=10%`, `3` at `cpu=35%`, `2` at `cpu=50%`, always showing `(max N)` in text).
4. **Burst-denial logging & Measurement Plan (`bin/cargo`, `ADR-82`, `STORY-80`, PR #10 body):**
   - `builds.jsonl` finish records now include `"burst_denied":"<disabled|prio|mem|cooldown|psi-unreadable|io|cpu>"` whenever a build checked a free burst slot and was denied.
   - Fixed `ADR-82` worst-case job count (8 rustc jobs = 4 slots x `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2` on 6 cores) and added the post-merge Measurement Plan to `ADR-82`, `STORY-80`, and the PR #10 description.
